source_quotes: why would a step index ever repeat … not a fail or retry … just change the step index
work should be done to prevent this error not a fail or retry
overlap_check: Related to 31 (no skip): this is the 'fix it' branch for invariants. Related to 22 (blueprint steps come from rules): that one is about where steps come from, this about their indices. New.

payload.name: Establish Invariants by Construction, Not by Failing
payload.description: When code can establish an ordering or identity invariant, it assigns it once, centrally, when the plan is populated. It does not fail, replan or retry because the model repeated an index.

principles.name: Prevent, do not punish
principles.description: An invariant that code can establish is established; a failure or replan for it wastes a model call and a walk.

heuristics.condition: a plan is invalid only because an index repeats
heuristics.action: normalize it deterministically and report what changed

heuristics.condition: one element of a list fails strict parsing
heuristics.action: rebuild it from its own fields instead of dropping it

decision_rules.name: Assign once at population
decision_rules.condition: an ordering or identity invariant such as a step index is needed
decision_rules.outcome: assign it centrally when the list is populated, by position with order preserved; never fail, replan, retry or pause for it

decision_rules.name: Remap and report
decision_rules.condition: indices repeat or point at nothing
decision_rules.outcome: remap dependencies by rule: a unique index points at that step, a repeated index points at its carriers before the dependent step, a dangling index is dropped; record an event naming what changed

decision_rules.name: Salvage, never skip
decision_rules.outcome: rebuild it leniently from its own fields, keeping its text and defaulting the rest; never drop it

decision_rules.name: Append without moving
decision_rules.condition: steps are added to a plan that is already running
decision_rules.outcome: give them the next unused index and leave every existing index and position where it is

decision_rules.name: Retire the failure check
decision_rules.condition: a normalization replaces an invalid-plan check
decision_rules.outcome: remove the old check and its event in the same change and cite the superseder
